description: The SPW project releases a coarse synthetic population for Denmark with people, households and assigned activity sites. Zenodo lists a public CC BY 4.0 archive, README, contact matrix and validation material. The README specifies CSVs for demographic agents, household IDs, residences, activity locations and person-to-place assignments. GPW counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived places appear in its source table. These synthetic daily locations may help initialise agent-based infrastructure-access or emergency-service demand tests for Denmark. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this deposit. A limitation is that the README omits a named household-distribution source despite listing household output tables, so that aspect of provenance is incomplete. Daily activity assignments are not observed travel diaries or evidence of actual service load. The ZIP was not downloaded and its census consistency and geographic coordinates were not checked.
